title: AEIBReceipt_v0.4.0
description: AEIB v0.4.0 execution receipt schema. Binds canonicalization to RFC 8785 with UTF-16 code-unit key ordering (implemented in src/jcs_canonicalizer.py; NFC is an opt-in ingress pre-pass, never applied inside JCS per RFC 8785 Section 3.1). Defines the dual DORA Article 17 timestamps and the aeib_compaction_safe_v2 marker; fields marked 'not yet emitted' are schema-level definitions with no engine emitter at the time of authoring and must not be reported as implemented capabilities.

receipt_type.description: Receipt class, e.g. EXECUTION_INTEGRITY_RECEIPT or RESEARCH_PROVENANCE_RECEIPT.

caid.description: Canonical Action Identifier derived by src/aeib_v040_engine.derive_caid over noun/verb/payload.

disposition.description: Fail-closed Layer 7c disposition vocabulary. DISPATCHED_UNCONFIRMED is the post-dispatch ambiguity state (spec term CLAIMED); OUTCOME_VERIFIED is out-of-band probe confirmation (spec term SUPPORTED_BY_EVIDENCE); PROBE_OUTAGE_HOLD freezes on transport ambiguity (HTTP 504 / TCP RST).

retry_safe.description: Re-dispatch permission. Latches false on ambiguous or unconfirmed transport; re-issuance requires a proven idempotency contract.

latch_engaged.description: True when the fail-closed lockout latch is engaged for this effect, physically blocking speculative retries.

retry_policy.description: Named retry policy applied by the Layer 7c derivation (e.g. PROHIBITED_DEFAULT_LATCH).

mapping_rule_id.description: Identifier of the transport-to-disposition mapping rule that produced this disposition.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonicalized payload as produced by encode_jcs.

previous_hash.description: Optional append-only hash-chain link to the preceding receipt in the audit sequence.

canonicalization.description: Binds the receipt to a single canonicalization profile so verifiers cannot disagree on byte-level serialization.

implementation.description: Single source of truth shared by cose_signer.py and cose_verifier.py.

key_sorting.description: RFC 8785 Section 3.2.3: object keys ordered by UTF-16 code units.

normalization.description: String data is preserved as-is inside JCS (RFC 8785 Section 3.1). NFC normalization is applied only when a caller invokes normalize_nfc() at ingress before canonicalization.

detection_timestamp_utc.description: DORA Article 17 detection timestamp of the incident. Schema-level definition only: no engine emitter exists at authoring time (not yet emitted).

notification_timestamp_utc.description: DORA Article 17 initial-notification timestamp. Schema-level definition only: no engine emitter exists at authoring time (not yet emitted).

probe_authority.description: Identity of the out-of-band probe authority that produced the disposition (e.g. SQLiteOutcomeProbeAdapter).

consistency_scope.description: Declared consistency scope within which the probe result is authoritative.

aeib_compaction_safe_v2.description: Compaction Classifier Protocol marker for structural constraint retention across context compression. Schema-level definition only: the classifier protocol is not implemented at authoring time (PROPOSED; see config/claims.jsonl CLM-09).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature hex over the canonicalized receipt payload.

signer_pubkey.description: 32-byte Ed25519 public key hex of the attestor.
